{{Quote|Like my mother told all eighty of us kids—it'd never work out! Marry a nice girl from a nice burrow.|[[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]]|<ref name="Behemoth from the World Below">[[Star Wars (1977) 10|''Star Wars'' (1977) 10]]</ref>}}
'''Jaxxon's mother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lepi/Legends|Lepi]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coachelle Prime/Legends|Coachelle Prime]]. She was the mother of thirteen children, among them, the infamous [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]]. She attempted to instill a sense of family values in her young son, but he remained too rambunctious for her to control. At the age of twelve, Jaxxon stole a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], and headed for the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="Starhoppers">{{GamerCite|4|The Starhoppers of Aduba-3}}</ref>

Years later, Jaxxon's sense for exaggeration would cause him to exclaim that his mother had produced eighty children during the [[Star-Hoppers of Aduba-3]]'s [[Battle of Aduba-3|battle]] with the [[Behemoth from the World Below]].<ref name="Behemoth from the World Below" />
